key_insight: ARDY enables real-time, interactive 3D human motion generation by combining online text/kinematic control with a hybrid representation and streaming autoregressive diffusion.
engineering_relevance: The method is directly relevant to animation, simulation, and humanoid robotics because it supports low-latency motion synthesis with flexible long-horizon constraints.
method: Hybrid motion encoding: explicit root features plus a latent body embedding.
Two-stage autoregressive transformer denoiser with variable history context.
Trained on text labels and kinematic constraints sampled from ground-truth poses for online controllability.
evidence_signal: The paper reports strong results on HumanML3D and the large-scale Bones Rigplay dataset, showing high motion quality and good constraint adherence.
watch_item: Interactive performance and constraint fidelity may depend on dataset coverage and the quality of sampled text/pose constraints, especially for very long-horizon or unusual motions.
paper_title: ARDY: Autoregressive Diffusion with Hybrid Representation for Interactive Human Motion Generation
